mission.name: BIRDS-4 / Tsuru concept study
mission.conOps: BIRDS-4-inspired 1U concept: maintain housekeeping and CW beacon service, schedule camera imaging, planned APRS/store-and-forward activities and attitude/technology experiments, then inspect overlapping demand and reduced-generation essential service. Activity context is sourced from Shrestha et al. (2022), §§3–5.6. SF-WARD flight exchange failed. The 400 km circular orbit is representative, not an epoch reconstruction. One-year lifetime and all numerical powers, schedules, rails and energy criteria are editable study assumptions. AZUR/BP8/P80 are illustrative COTS substitutions, not BIRDS-4 flight hardware.

scenarios.name: BIRDS-4 · Routine operations
scenarios.description: BIRDS-4-inspired housekeeping, CW beacon, camera, APRS and attitude experiments. Editable demonstration powers and duty cycles, not flight telemetry.
scenarios.provenance: BIRDS-4 activities: Shrestha et al. (2022), §§3–5.6, https://nanosat11th.itu.edu.tr/assets/papers/BIRDS-4.pdf. All mode powers, phase placements, rail assignments, illumination factors and energy criteria below are authored demo assumptions. This is a BIRDS-4-inspired study, not a reconstruction of its flight power system or operational timeline. SF-WARD is a planned activity whose on-orbit communication failure is reported in §5.3.

scenarios.name: BIRDS-4 · Overlapping missions
scenarios.description: A hypothetical two-orbit stress case. Extended camera, APRS and actuator operation coincide. With the illustrative default COTS allocation, generation and replenishment fail even though the oversized pack avoids depletion during this interval. Not a historical BIRDS-4 schedule.
scenarios.provenance: BIRDS-4 activities: Shrestha et al. (2022), §§3–5.6, https://nanosat11th.itu.edu.tr/assets/papers/BIRDS-4.pdf. All mode powers, phase placements, rail assignments, illumination factors and energy criteria below are authored demo assumptions. This is a BIRDS-4-inspired study, not a reconstruction of its flight power system or operational timeline. SF-WARD is a planned activity whose on-orbit communication failure is reported in §5.3.

scenarios.name: BIRDS-4 · Reduced generation
scenarios.description: A three-orbit illustrative survival interval inspired by the reported BIRDS-4 generation shortfall. Only housekeeping and a short CW beacon remain scheduled. No automatic recovery is modeled.
scenarios.provenance: BIRDS-4 activities: Shrestha et al. (2022), §§3–5.6, https://nanosat11th.itu.edu.tr/assets/papers/BIRDS-4.pdf.
